The main takeaway from our work is that
the prefrontal cortical network has a critical role to play in the maintenance of goal representations, and that this maintenance is critical to the cognitive control of thought and action.
cognitive control can be understood as an active, goal-directed process, which involves the maintenance of patterns of prefrontal activity that bias the flow of activity in other brain structures.
